source.author: stat
source.text: forsitan et victo prior isset Arion e Cygnus, sed vetat aequorcus vinci pater: hinc vice iusta gloria mansit equo, cessit victoria vati.
source.text_original: forsitan et victo prior isset Arion e Cygnus, / sed vetat aequorcus vinci pater: hinc vice iusta / gloria mansit equo, cessit victoria vati.
source.text_english: Perhaps Arion, too, had gone before the conquered swan in the race, but the sea-born father forbids defeat: thus by rightful turn glory remained with the horse, victory yielded to the bard.
